node.statement: Involution and unit. Decomposing X into its four source corners and summing the involution-compatibility clause of def-four-corner-merging-datum gives ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=4rho||X||. Also gamma_n(I)=gamma_11,n(I_n tensor Pi_1)+gamma_22,n(I_n tensor Pi_2); the two diagonal-unit bounds and target complementarity give ||gamma_n(I)-I||<=3rho (with harmless enlargement if the datum uses the common bound for complementarity). Both are at most universal multiples of e.
